rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Motecloud is a managed graph memory service for production AI systems, providing tenant-scoped graph storage with hybrid retrieval combining graph traversal, embeddings, reranking, and activation mechanisms. The hosted MCP server offers durable agent memory with signed audit trails, replayable event history, tenant isolation, and machine-discoverable pricing for autonomous agent billing.
